name: Pope Damasus I
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 366 to 384
contribution: The bishop of Rome from October 366 to his death in 384.

checks.lead: Pope Damasus I (; c. 305 – 11 December 384), also known as Damasus of Rome, was the bishop of Rome from October 366 to his death in 384. He presided over the Council of Rome of 382, which established the canon, or official list, of sacred scripture.
